final_message:
The bug has been fixed. The issue was that the `get()` method wasn't removing the accessed key from the order list before appending it, which caused duplicate entries. This broke the LRU eviction logic because when a subsequent `put()` operation tried to evict the oldest item, it would incorrectly remove one of the duplicates instead of the truly least recently used item.

The fix adds `self.order.remove(key)` before `self.order.append(key)` in the `get()` method, ensuring proper recency tracking on access.
